commands.name: bind-actual-source-and-unchanged-helper-schema
argv:
import hashlib,subprocess,sys,tarfile
from pathlib import Path
f=Path('/home/barami/projects/industrial-opportunity-resolution-mvp/.autonomous-workflow/mission-20260925/ministry-foundation/replacement-2/r1-successor'); e=Path('/home/barami/projects/industrial-opportunity-resolution-mvp/.autonomous-workflow/mission-20260925/ministry-decision'); r=Path('/home/barami/projects/industrial-opportunity-resolution-mvp/.autonomous-workflow/mission-20260925/ministry-decision/r1-successor-replacement-2')
sys.path.insert(0,str(f/'helpers'))
import compare
candidate=compare.parse_json((e/'final-candidate-replacement-2/BINDING.json').read_text())
assert candidate['proof_root']=='/home/barami/projects/industrial-opportunity-resolution-mvp/.autonomous-workflow/mission-20260925/ministry-decision/final-candidate-replacement-2/proof'
for expression,key in [('HEAD','proof_commit'),('HEAD^{tree}','candidate_tree')]:
    compare.check(subprocess.check_output(['git','--no-optional-locks','-C',candidate['proof_root'],'rev-parse',expression],text=True).strip()==candidate[key], 'candidate/'+key, 'FINAL_RECEIPT_MISMATCH')
b=compare.parse_json((f/'RUNTIME-BINDING.json').read_text())
inventory={}
for path in sorted((r/'source').rglob('*')):
    name=path.relative_to(r/'source').as_posix()
    compare.valid_path(name,'source/path')
    compare.check(not path.is_symlink(),'source/path','SYMLINK_FORBIDDEN')
    if path.is_file(): inventory[name]=hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
    else: compare.check(path.is_dir(),'source/path','SPECIAL_FILE_FORBIDDEN')
archive_inventory={}
with tarfile.open(r/'source.tar','r') as archive:
    for member in archive.getmembers():
        if member.isdir(): continue
        compare.check(member.isfile(),'archive/path','ONLY_REGULAR_SOURCE_FILES')
        if member.name=='.env.example': continue
        compare.valid_path(member.name,'archive/path')
        compare.check(member.name not in archive_inventory,'archive/path','DUPLICATE_PATH')
        archive_inventory[member.name]=hashlib.sha256(archive.extractfile(member).read()).hexdigest()
compare.check(inventory==archive_inventory,'source/archive','ARCHIVE_INVENTORY_MISMATCH')
current=compare.parse_json((r/'source/data/graph/current.json').read_text())
compare.check(current['projection_id']=='GRAPH-SAU-2026-09-12-c9841fe8e850','source/projection','WRONG_CURRENT_GRAPH')
b.update(candidate_tree=candidate['candidate_tree'],proof_commit=candidate['proof_commit'],projection_id='GRAPH-SAU-2026-09-12-c9841fe8e850',old_token='ENGINE-64e24689a59f',new_token='ENGINE-941521e7a5e5',source_inventory=inventory,source_inventory_sha256=compare.digest(inventory))
compare.validate_binding(b)
compare.write_new(r/'RUNTIME-BINDING.json',b)
print('R1_RUNTIME_BINDING_WRITTEN',len(inventory),'source files', 'binding_file_sha256='+hashlib.sha256((r/'RUNTIME-BINDING.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'binding_canonical_sha256='+compare.digest(b), 'archive_sha256='+hashlib.sha256((r/'source.tar').read_bytes()).hexdigest())

argv:
import hashlib,sys
from pathlib import Path
f=Path('/home/barami/projects/industrial-opportunity-resolution-mvp/.autonomous-workflow/mission-20260925/ministry-foundation/replacement-2/r1-successor'); r=Path('/home/barami/projects/industrial-opportunity-resolution-mvp/.autonomous-workflow/mission-20260925/ministry-decision/r1-successor-replacement-2')
sys.path.insert(0,str(f/'helpers'))
import compare
expected={'en':'433fa0aabed03a27aa57c9c26a6ccef4b347f0892df90f9d0cc68a4556b7beca','ar':'831a96071fe7aab1a5b6a37fa7ccc817d229b48a0669d43f23dba1d6a71602e8'}
comparison=compare.parse_json((r/'output/COMPARISON.json').read_text())
compare.check(comparison['pass'] is True,'M/comparison','R1_MUST_PASS_FIRST')
for locale,digest in expected.items():
    path=f/'output/measurements'/(locale+'-N.json')
    compare.check(hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==digest,locale,'F_REFERENCE_HASH')
    old=compare.parse_json(path.read_text())
    current=compare.parse_json((r/'output/measurements'/(locale+'-O.json')).read_text())
    compare.equal(current['measurement'],old['measurement'],locale+'/M-O-vs-F-N','F_GEOMETRY_OR_TEXT_DRIFT')
print('M_O_EQUALS_DELIVERED_F_N_BOTH_LOCALES')
